_comment: SANITISED, Core-owned federation observability SNAPSHOT for the FOM (Federation Operations Map). Aggregate + BANDED counts only — NO PII, NO identities, NO CPIF values, NO internal IDs, NO permissions/authority. Point-in-time (see generatedAt), NOT live: the map OBSERVES the federation and is NEVER a source of truth. Generated by a read-only governance-time sweep (governance/drift-sweep-runbook-v1.md), then sanitised + banded. People-count bands (R0 EO 2026-06-18): 0 / Active (1-4) / 5-9 / 10-19 / 20+ — never an exact count <5 at a named entity. Integrity counts are STRUCTURAL (exact), not people. A value that could not be verified is null, never a guess.
note: v14 (2026-11-26, bus 164): re-pinned to registry v14; no counts were re-read, so generatedAt stays 2026-11-25. The identity entry in this snapshot is the CPIF layer, not the Keycloak provider: the layer stays live (RusJAz carries the subject identifier), while the Keycloak provider is shown as retiring in registry.public.json coreServices (R0 act 2026-11-14; the endpoint still runs). MoyPolk shows no identity value (retired). Was: registryVersion 13. v13 (2026-11-25, bus 163, R0 «go» 25.11): after the bus-162 findings — community.group identity "off" (federated sign-in switched off by the R0 act of 2026-11-06; registry v13 adds the value `off`); the ZNANIYE institution node got its slug, so strayNodes is back to the baseline 1; the 2 ACTIVE memberships left on the archived demo node were closed, so subjectsOnNonCanonicalNodes is now the UX-audit test fixture only (due for deletion 2026-11-30). Counts re-read on RusJAz after the fixes, same day. Was: registryVersion 12, community-group identity "connected", strayNodes 2, subjectsOnNonCanonicalNodes "5-9". v12 (2026-11-25, bus 161, R0 «go» 25.11): regenerated by the read-only drift sweep against registry v12 — RusJAz (psql), community.group + MoyPolk (Supabase), taxonomy API (public). Changes from the 2026-06-18 snapshot: RUSJAZ-FDN removed (retired into the one CEA CIC, registry v9); ZNANIYE, BALTICA and RU-ONLINE-EUREKA parented to CEA; ZNANIYE-STRATFORD and ZNANIYE-FINCHLEY added; MoyPolk shown as retired (brand retired into Community Group 2026-11-03), geography served by community.group; identity no longer means Keycloak (R0 act 2026-11-14). Member bands = distinct ACTIVE team members on the RusJAz nodes anchored to the code (CEA is anchored on both RusJAz and community.group; its band counts the RusJAz CEA CIC node only). Institution region = the node's ITL1 code, else the one region all its campuses share. Was: generatedAt 2026-06-18, geography steward MoyPolk, RUSJAZ-FDN as FOUNDATION parent of ZNANIYE and BALTICA, strayNodes 1, subjectsOnNonCanonicalNodes Active, community-group cpifLinked Active.
